common.style: GLOBAL STYLE: Grounded, lived-in cinematic science fiction, year 2083. Shot on 35mm motion picture film: fine organic grain, gentle halation around practical lights, soft roll-off in highlights, natural motion blur at 180-degree shutter. Muted palette built on warm sodium-orange practical light against cold steel-blue ambient light. Photoreal, 16:9. No readable text, no logos, no music, no cartoon or CGI look.
common.character: CHARACTERS: Exactly one person in focus: Cass Varro, the man shown in @Image1 (front), @Image2 (three-quarter, half-smile) and @Image3 (profile). Keep his exact face from those references throughout: late 30s, weathered sun-damaged skin, three-day stubble going grey at the chin, short dark wavy hair with the side shaved close, small brushed-steel neural jack port behind his ear, tired hooded eyes, crooked half-smile. @Image4 shows his wardrobe only: faded rust-orange flight jacket with dark patched elbows and a worn shoulder patch, grey thermal henley, leather utility belt with a battered rugged tablet and a coiled tether line.
common.locks: IDENTITY LOCK: the same face as @Image1-@Image3 in every frame, no face morphing, no aging change, no second person resembling him. Wardrobe stays exactly as @Image4.

clips.a_cockpit:
SCENE: Alone in the cramped cockpit of an old long-haul freight hauler, Cass runs a pre-burn check and is quietly pleased with himself.

LOCATION: Tight, cluttered cockpit. A wall of chunky toggle switches, taped-over analog gauges, flickering amber segment readouts, hanging cable bundles, a dented coffee bulb velcroed to the dash, a scratched canopy window behind showing a cold blue planet limb and stars.

FIRST FRAME AND BLOCKING: Cass sits in the worn pilot seat at frame-center-left, body angled toward the console at frame-right, face in three-quarter view toward camera. Camera sits just in front of the console looking back at him.

Shot 1: Medium close-up. He flicks three toggle switches in quick succession with his right hand; one amber readout stutters, flickers, then holds steady. He glances back over his left shoulder toward the dark rear of the cabin, then turns his head back toward the console and lets a small crooked smirk spread across his face. Single continuous shot, no cuts.

OPTICS / CAMERA: LENS LOCK 47 degree normal lens, camera at eye height, subtle handheld float with a very slow push-in. No lens drift.

PHYSICS: Dust motes drift through the light, jacket fabric creases naturally as he turns, cables sway slightly with ship vibration.

LIGHTING: Flickering amber console light from below and frame-right sculpts his face; cold blue starlight from the canopy rims his hair and shoulder from behind. Deep shadows in the cabin corners.

AUDIO: Heavy toggle switch clicks, a low electrical hum, soft console beeps, a distant hull creak. No music, no dialogue.
clips.b_docking:
SCENE: Cass walks down his ship's cargo ramp into a steam-filled docking bay, tablet in hand, arguing quietly into his comm.

LOCATION: Cavernous industrial docking bay at night. Scuffed steel cargo ramp with yellow-black hazard edging, venting steam plumes drifting across the frame, harsh sodium-orange floodlights on high gantries, cold blue work lights on the far wall, stacked shipping containers and a cargo loader in soft background.

FIRST FRAME AND BLOCKING: Cass is at the top of the ramp at frame-center, walking toward camera, the open cargo hold glowing orange behind him. He holds the battered tablet in his right hand at waist height, reading it, and his left index finger presses the small comm unit at his left ear.

Shot 1: Medium-wide shot becoming a medium shot as he approaches. He walks down the ramp toward camera through a curtain of drifting steam, glancing between the tablet and straight ahead, jaw tight, speaking in a low irritated mutter into the comm, shaking his head once. Single continuous shot, no cuts. His face stays clearly visible and in focus as he nears camera.

OPTICS / CAMERA: LENS LOCK 47 degree normal lens, camera at chest height on a slow backward dolly, keeping him centered. No lens drift.

PHYSICS: Steam billows and curls around his legs and is backlit by floodlights; jacket hangs heavy and swings with his stride; coiled tether sways at his hip.

LIGHTING: Hard sodium-orange floodlight backlight from above and behind him creates a rim and glowing steam; cold blue bounce from the bay fills the front of his face. Motivated, high contrast.

AUDIO: Steam hiss, boots on steel ramp, distant machinery clanks and a warning chime, his voice as a low muffled mutter with no discernible words. No music.
clips.c_bar:
SCENE: In a grimy spaceport bar, Cass leans on the counter and slides a data chip to a contact just off-screen, with a raised eyebrow that says this better be worth it.

LOCATION: Cramped, smoky dockside bar. Scratched steel counter with rings from old drinks, a half-empty glass of amber liquor, flickering cold-blue tube light behind the bar, warm orange pendant lamp above the counter, shelves of mismatched bottles, other patrons only as soft out-of-focus shapes deep in the background.

FIRST FRAME AND BLOCKING: Cass leans with both forearms on the counter at frame-left-of-center, facing frame-right toward an unseen person just outside frame-right, face in three-quarter view toward camera. A small matte-black data chip lies under his right index finger on the counter.

Shot 1: Medium close-up. He slides the data chip slowly across the counter toward frame-right with two fingers and lets go, holds the unseen contact's gaze, then raises one eyebrow and gives the faintest crooked half-smile. Single continuous shot, no cuts.

OPTICS / CAMERA: LENS LOCK 29 degree portrait lens, camera at counter height slightly below his eyeline, locked-off with a barely perceptible drift. Shallow depth of field. No lens drift.

PHYSICS: A thin haze of smoke hangs and drifts through the lamp light; the chip slides with slight friction and stops cleanly.

LIGHTING: Warm orange pendant from above-left rakes across his face and the counter; cold blue tube light from behind rims his shaved side and the jack port. Low-key, deep shadows.

COUNT LOCK: exactly one person in focus. No second hand enters frame, background figures stay blurred with no visible faces.

AUDIO: Low murmur of an indistinct crowd, a glass set down, the soft scrape of the chip on steel. No music, no discernible dialogue.
